senses.gloss: (sec. r. of <cite ref="A00658"><he>אוּל</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A00658"><he>אֲוַל</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="P00815"><he>עלל</he></cite>)
to circle. Pi. אִילֵּל to go around; to espy, track. Cant. R. beg. (play on תּוּר a. תּוֹרָה) אחר ד״ת אִילַּלְתָּ thou didst search after the words of the Law.
units: Pesik. R. s. 47 ḥafar (Job XXXIX, 29) לשון מְאַלֵּל has the meaning of espying (ed. incorr. יליל, v. ed. Friedm. p. 190ᵇ).—[

senses.gloss: to tie around; to be strong; v. אֵל, אלי I, אֵלָה, אִילָּן &c., a. אלם.]
